mentions.name: Vibescape
mentions.description: Immersive meditation app for Apple Vision Pro featuring immersive environments that come alive with music; launched as a day one Vision Pro app and currently featured on the App Store.
mentions.source_excerpt: Vibescape: an immersive meditation app. This one is currently featured at the top of the App Store, yay! Launched as a day one app on Vision Pro, new update has what I think is the best immersive environment I've made yet that comes alive with music: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vibescape/id6476827678
